build_FPN_neck: build a Feature Pyramid Network neck module for multi-scale feature extraction in semantic segmentation
create_FPN_with_lateral_convs: create an FPN instance with lateral convolutions to project backbone features to uniform channel dimensions
build_FPN_top_down_path: build the top-down path in FPN by upsampling and adding features from higher to lower pyramid levels
create_FPN_extra_convs: create extra convolution layers on top of FPN outputs for additional pyramid levels using on_input on_lateral or on_output mode
review_FPN_forward: review the FPN forward pass that builds laterals, top-down path, and outputs from backbone feature inputs
